settings.title: Settings
settings.terminalDesc: Customize the terminal appearance and behavior.
settings.fontSizeDesc: Size of text in the terminal (10-24px)
settings.fontFamilyDesc: Monospace font used in the terminal
settings.scrollbackLinesDesc: Number of lines to keep in history (1,000-100,000)
settings.aiPredictionDesc: Use your own OpenAI-compatible or Claude-compatible API key to predict inline command ghost text.
settings.aiPredictionEnabledDesc: Show AI predictions as ghost text only; commands are never executed automatically.
settings.aiPredictionProviderDesc: Choose the API format used for prediction requests.
settings.aiPredictionApiKeyDesc: Bring your own key. It is stored in VibeShell settings on this device.
settings.aiPredictionBaseUrlDesc: Override for compatible gateways or self-hosted proxies.
settings.aiPredictionModelDesc: Model name sent to the selected provider.
settings.aiPredictionMinCharsDesc: Start prediction only after this many typed characters.
settings.aiPredictionDebounceDesc: Wait after typing before sending a prediction request.
settings.appearanceDesc: Customize the look and feel of VibeShell.
settings.sshDefaultsDesc: Default values for new SSH connections.
settings.defaultPortDesc: Default SSH port for new connections
settings.connectionTimeoutDesc: Maximum time to wait for connection
settings.keepaliveIntervalDesc: Interval between keepalive packets (0 to disable)
settings.cloudSyncDesc: Sync workspace data through GitHub Gist, WebDAV, or a portable file.
settings.cloudGistIdDesc: Optional. Leave empty to create a private Gist with the token.
settings.cloudGithubTokenDesc: Requires the Gists permission. The token stays in memory and in the pairing code only.
settings.cloudWebDavEndpointDesc: Full HTTPS URL of the JSON file to create or reuse.
settings.cloudPairingCodeWarning: This code contains the vault key. Keep it private; it is not saved by VibeShell.
settings.cloudPortableFileDesc: Import or export servers, groups, and snippets as versioned JSON. Credentials, fingerprints, and recordings are excluded; the file may contain sensitive hostnames and commands.
settings.refreshIntervalDesc: How often to update server status metrics
settings.autoExpandPanelDesc: Automatically expand the status panel when connecting
settings.showNetworkRatesDesc: Display network transfer rates instead of total bytes
settings.fileTransferDesc: Configure recursive SFTP upload and sync behavior.
settings.respectGitignoreDesc: Apply .gitignore rules from the uploaded directory and its subdirectories.
settings.uploadExcludePatternsDesc: One pattern per line. Used by VibeShell directory upload and sync.
settings.securityDesc: Manage SSH host key verification and security settings.
settings.hostKeyFingerprintsDesc: {{count}} trusted host(s) stored. Manage the list of trusted SSH server fingerprints.
settings.recordingDesc: Record terminal sessions for review and auditing. Right-click a session tab to start recording.
settings.storageLocationDesc: Recordings are stored in the application data directory.
settings.noRecordings: No recordings yet. Right-click a session tab to start recording.
settings.gatewayDesc: Agents connect directly to this VibeShell window and share its SSH sessions with you.
settings.gatewaySharedGui: Agent actions use this visible workspace.
settings.skillsDesc: Install Gateway instructions for direct SSH and SFTP access from your AI coding tools.
settings.noToolsDetected: No supported AI tools detected on your system.
settings.supportedTools: Supported tools: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Open Code, Pi
settings.resetSettingsDesc: Restore all settings to their default values.

server-performance.name: Server Performance
server-performance.description: Live CPU, memory, disk, network, load and uptime metrics for the active host.

docker-containers.description: Inspect containers, images, live resource usage and recent container logs through the remote Docker CLI.

kubernetes-pods.name: Kubernetes Pods
kubernetes-pods.description: Inspect cluster contexts, namespaces, pods, deployments and workload logs with kubectl.

database-inspector.name: Database Inspector
database-inspector.description: Read PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite metadata using credentials already configured on the remote server.

process-explorer.name: Process Explorer
process-explorer.description: Inspect active processes and resource consumption without interrupting the terminal.

system-logs.name: System Logs
system-logs.description: Read recent systemd journal entries and service logs from the active server.

network-inspector.name: Network Inspector
network-inspector.description: Inspect listening sockets, routes and DNS configuration on the connected server.

disk-usage.name: Disk Usage
disk-usage.description: Inspect filesystems and directory usage before a full disk becomes an incident.

git-workspace.name: Git Workspace
git-workspace.description: Inspect repository status, branches and recent commits in the remote login directory.
